verdict.rationale: Persona's inquiry templates hold a use case's screens, verifications, decisioning and theming as configuration, and Dynamic Flow Templates add dynamic friction, which covers conditional steps. Workflows add risk-based logic: they start from triggers, auto-tag high-risk inquiries, run extra reports when conditions are met, and automate manual decisions. Cases adds a configurable ops UI with automations. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a no-code or visual editor for templates and workflows, any documentation of country-specific requirement configuration, explicit confirmation that template changes go live without an engineering deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
